result.title: AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior
result.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Project page and code: https://ada-zy2425.github.io/AlignHand/
result.summary: Modern monocular hand estimators recover detailed 3D meshes from individual images, yet effectively leveraging their predictions across multiple views remains challenging. Independently predicted meshes can disagree in scale, placement, and articulation, limiting the integration of complementary multi-view information. Hence, we present AlignHand, a calibrated multi-view framework that builds on a frozen monocular hand reconstruction prior to align and enhance its predictions. Specifically, AlignHand refines cross-view joint observations and estimates their reliability to establish a shared metric reference for alignment. Once the meshes are brought into a common frame, their complementary surface evidence is selectively fused across anatomical regions, followed by pixel-aligned refinement that predicts bounded residual displacements from local image features. This global-to-local integration enables AlignHand to exploit complementary observations while preserving the strong monocular prior. Extensive experiments on DexYCB-MV, HanCo, and HO3D-Eval-MV demonstrate that AlignHand achieves the lowest MPVPE and MPJPE among the compared methods under the respective evaluation protocols, reducing MPVPE by 30.1%, 29.1%, and 8.0%, respectively, compared with a matched geometry baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AlignHand，在冻结的单目手部重建先验之上做多视角校准：先以跨视角关节观测及其可靠性估计建立共享度量参考完成对齐，再按解剖区域选择性融合互补表面证据，并用局部图像特征预测有界残差做像素对齐细化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按可靠性加权、按区域筛选并融合多源视觉证据」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与多假设取舍提供可核查的外部线索，但该文属 3D 几何重建任务，与推理状态生成无直接关系。
